text: The Patriots face a critical test this Sunday at 1 PM ET against the Steelers in their home opener at Gillette Stadium, but they'll do so without one of their most important weapons after A.J. Brown suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 that will land him on injured reserve for at least four games, forcing Mike Reiss and other beat writers to examine who steps up in the receiver's absence as Drake Maye attempts to lead a bounce-back performance. Off the field, the Kraft family and Patriots organization have demonstrated their commitment to the community this week—the Myra Kraft Community MVP Award program recognized 26 volunteers with a combined $275,000 in donations, while Maye and his wife Ann Michael sponsored classroom wish lists for over 50 teachers at an elementary school in Providence—and owner Robert Kraft made headlines by removing Macklemore as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming Gillette shows, citing the artist's "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery" as offensive to the Jewish community. In roster moves, the Patriots re-signed safety Elliott Davison to the practice squad while releasing tight end Shane Zylstra from the same unit.
